# Feature development skills

One entry point, four stage skills. Call **`/develop-feature <ticket-number>`** and the rest is chained automatically.
Each stage skill can also be invoked on its own (for example to re-run exploratory testing or regenerate a report).

## Pipeline

| Order | Skill | Purpose | Main output |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | [develop-feature](develop-feature/SKILL.md) | Orchestrates the stages below, implements the feature, fixes defects, commits | Feature branch with code, tests and report |
| 1 | [refine-ticket](refine-ticket/SKILL.md) | Fetch the ticket, derive what can be derived, ask multiple-choice questions only for real ambiguity, assess risk | `docs/tickets/<id>/ticket.json`, `requirements.json` |
| 2 | [write-e2e-tests](write-e2e-tests/SKILL.md) | **Design**: risk-based, technique-driven Gherkin scenarios (before coding). **Automate**: step definitions + run (after coding) | `tests/e2e/features/tickets/ticket-<id>-<slug>.feature`, steps |
| – | _implementation_ (inside develop-feature) | Build the feature following [copilot-instructions.md](../copilot-instructions.md) | Code changes |
| 3 | [exploratory-testing](exploratory-testing/SKILL.md) | Charter-based exploratory sessions with `playwright-cli` | `docs/tickets/<id>/exploratory.json`, screenshots |
| 4 | [test-report](test-report/SKILL.md) | Deterministic Markdown report generated by script | `docs/tickets/<id>/report.md` |

```text
develop-feature <id>
  ├─ 1 refine-ticket ───────────── ticket.json + requirements.json (asks only what cannot be derived)
  ├─ 2a write-e2e-tests (design) ─ .feature file (tests first)
  ├─ implement feature ─────────── code
  ├─ 2b write-e2e-tests (automate) steps + green run (ticket + regression)
  ├─ 3 exploratory-testing ─────── exploratory.json  ──┐ defects? fix → back to 2b (max 3 loops)
  └─ 4 test-report ─────────────── report.md          ◄┘
```

## Worked example – ticket #1 "Create kawaii doomsday stories"

All examples use the same ticket so you can follow one feature through the whole pipeline. Read them in this order:

1. [refine-ticket/examples/01-clarification-walkthrough.md](refine-ticket/examples/01-clarification-walkthrough.md) – what was derived vs. asked
2. [refine-ticket/examples/02-requirements.json](refine-ticket/examples/02-requirements.json) – refined criteria, decisions, risk
3. [write-e2e-tests/examples/01-test-design.md](write-e2e-tests/examples/01-test-design.md) – risk-based selection and techniques
4. [write-e2e-tests/examples/02-ticket-1-doomsday-stories.feature](write-e2e-tests/examples/02-ticket-1-doomsday-stories.feature) – resulting Gherkin
5. [write-e2e-tests/examples/03-doomsday-stories.steps.js](write-e2e-tests/examples/03-doomsday-stories.steps.js) – step definitions (clock + viewport)
6. [write-e2e-tests/examples/04-gherkin-do-and-dont.md](write-e2e-tests/examples/04-gherkin-do-and-dont.md) – style before/after
7. [exploratory-testing/examples/01-charters.md](exploratory-testing/examples/01-charters.md) – charters derived from risk
8. [exploratory-testing/examples/02-session-transcript.md](exploratory-testing/examples/02-session-transcript.md) – a `playwright-cli` session
9. [exploratory-testing/examples/03-exploratory.json](exploratory-testing/examples/03-exploratory.json) – the session log
10. [test-report/examples/report.md](test-report/examples/report.md) – the generated report

The live baseline suite in [tests/e2e/features/baseline](../../tests/e2e/features/baseline) is a second, runnable example of the Gherkin style.
